title: Exact linear functors preserve the signed Koszul completion model
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,R)$ and $(\mathcal D,S)$ be small ringed sites with commutative structure sheaves $R,S$, and let a commutative ring $A$ act on $R,S$ by global sections. Let $F:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(S)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] be additive [def-weil-pbc-additive-functor], exact and $A$-linear: $F(a f)=aF(f)$ for every $a\in A$ and module map $f$. Suppose its canonical countable-product comparison [def-weil-category-product] $F(\prod_m M_m)\to\prod_m F(M_m)$, characterized by the projections, is invertible. Assume countable products are exact in both module categories. Fix $r\ge0$ and $a_1,\ldots,a_r\in A$. For $m\ge1$ set $Q_m(R)=\bigotimes_{i=1}^r[R\xrightarrow{a_i^m}R]$ in degrees $[-r,0]$, with transitions multiplication by $a_i$ in degree $-1$ and identity in degree $0$ in each factor; define $Q_m(S)$ similarly. Use the total tensor convention [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For a complex $C$, set $B_R(C)=\prod_m(C\otimes_R Q_m(R))$, let $s$ be the transition shift, and define
$$H_R(C)^q=B_R(C)^q\oplus B_R(C)^{q-1},\qquad d(x,y)=(dx,(1-s)x-dy).$$
Let $\eta_C:C\to H_R(C)$ be $c\mapsto((c\otimes1)_m,0)$. Define $H_S(FC)$ and its unit by the same formulas. There is a natural chain isomorphism
$$h_C:F(H_R(C))\xrightarrow{\sim}H_S(FC),\qquad h_C F(\eta_C)=\eta_{FC},$$
using the canonical finite-biproduct comparisons and countable-product comparison, with the same ordering of Koszul factors. It descends to the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. Thus invertibility of $\eta_C$ in the derived category implies invertibility of $\eta_{FC}$. The empty scalar list is allowed. This is a statement about the explicit signed model, not a choice of a map between unspecified cones.

proof.text: The hypothesis on canonical countable-product comparisons gives preservation of limits of shape Discrete N. Map the limiting product fan, then compose its projection maps with alpha to obtain beta and its inverse. Product uniqueness proves their inverse laws, naturality, the transition-shift equation and the diagonal equation.

proof.text: Conjugate the canonical binary-biproduct comparison by the fibre coordinates, applying beta in degrees q and q-1. Check its differential by the two projections using the block matrix (d,0;1-shift,-d), including the index transport. The same projections prove naturality and the unit equation. This gives h with all specified coordinate equations.

proof.text: Use localization lifts for the fibre functors and units. Whisker h with Q and compose with the exact-functor derived factorization and the two fibre factorizations. Fully faithful precomposition by Q gives hd. The explicit lift equations give derived_factor and etaR_factor/etaS_factor. Prove the derived unit equality after precomposition by Q, canceling the factorization isomorphisms; localization faithfulness proves it everywhere. An isomorphism source unit has isomorphism image, and composition with hd gives the target unit isomorphism.

There is no re-split note for this item, and the delivery adds no new nodes. Statement change: it adds 'commutative structure sheaves R,S'. The tensor nodes it cites (def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product) are defined only for commutative rings, so this is a typing clarification and not a new hypothesis. It also adds citations for additive and product. The only citer, lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison (F=e_! on commutative A_T), is unaffected. Steps 1-6 are elementary and I checked each one. Step 1: the Koszul signs (-1)^p·epsilon(J,i), the transitions a_J and the explicit unit isomorphism. Step 2: the biproduct comparison through its two biproduct identities, with A-linearity of the entries. Step 3: the entrywise chain, transition and inclusion compatibility. Step 4: pr_m s = t_m pr_{m+1}, and beta is invertible through the assumed comparison phi. Step 5: I multiplied out the fibre block matrices. Step 6: (1-s)e=0 and the strict unit equality. Step 7: the statement of lem-sbc-koszul-fibre-linear-descent has the same Q_m, transitions, fibre (dx,(1-s)x-dy), coaugmentation, r=0 case and exact-products hypothesis, applied separately to R and S. lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated gives F_D. Step 8: localization universal property clauses (2) and (3) descend h and the unit. Edge cases tested: F=0, r=0 (constant tower), r=1 with a=0, and unbounded C. Stacks 0A0E (algebraization.tex:1091) is cited only for the model, and the proof is agent-written. No SGA. No cycle: the closure has 204 nodes and does not contain the item. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses. I accept the tool use of lem-sbc-koszul-fibre-linear-descent (unit sk-rem-rest, generic descent of the exact model).
